name: amp
title: Amp
description: Start, search, steer, and watch Amp threads, talk to Puck, and open orb portals. Requires the Amp CLI and a signed-in Amp account.
author: pc-style

commands.name: new-thread
commands.title: New Thread
commands.subtitle: Amp
commands.description: Compose a new Amp thread with a project, mode, and orb size.

commands.name: start-thread
commands.title: Start Thread
commands.subtitle: Amp
commands.description: Fire off an orb thread in your default project straight from the root search.

commands.name: search-threads
commands.title: Search Threads
commands.subtitle: Amp
commands.description: Search your threads with Amp's query syntax (repo:, author:, after:, pr:, …).

commands.name: thread-activity
commands.title: Thread Activity
commands.subtitle: Amp
commands.description: Menu bar inbox of threads that finished since you last looked.

commands.name: currently-running
commands.title: Currently Running
commands.subtitle: Amp
commands.description: Menu bar count of agents working right now.

commands.name: ask-puck
commands.title: Ask Puck
commands.subtitle: Amp
commands.description: Chat with Puck, your Amp assistant, in Raycast.

commands.name: call-puck
commands.title: Call Puck
commands.subtitle: Amp
commands.description: Start a voice call with Puck via the Amp Mac app's Call Puck shortcut.

commands.name: search-projects
commands.title: Search Projects
commands.subtitle: Amp
commands.description: Browse your Amp projects and start threads in them.

commands.name: open-portal
commands.title: Open Portal
commands.subtitle: Amp
commands.description: Open a portal of one of your running orbs, found in their transcripts.

preferences.name: ampPath
preferences.title: Amp CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the amp binary. Leave empty to look in ~/.amp/bin, ~/.local/bin, Homebrew, and /usr/local/bin.

preferences.name: accessToken
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Optional. Only needed when the CLI is not signed in. Create one at ampcode.com/settings/security.

preferences.name: defaultProject
preferences.title: Default Project
preferences.description: Project for Start Thread when none is given, as namespace/name.
